meta.name: detect-zero-iteration-failure
meta.description: Identify and classify agent failures occurring before execution starts

copy.tagline: 识别并分类代理启动前的失败原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到代理在开始执行前就失败的情况
copy.tagline_en: Identify and classify agent failures before execution starts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter agent failures before execution starts

howto.what: Claude 会识别并分类那些在任务开始执行前就失败的 Agent 运行，标记为“零迭代失败”，并建议检查系统环境而非 Agent 逻辑。
howto.when: 当任务报告 0 次迭代、无工具调用、无产出物，且日志以初始错误消息突然结束时触发。

say.text: 这个任务是否属于零迭代失败？
say.note: Claude 会检查迭代次数、工具调用和日志。

say.text: 分析这个日志中的初始化错误。
say.note: Claude 会标记失败模式并建议排查环境问题。

howto.what_en: Claude identifies and classifies agent failures that occur before any task execution, flagging them as 'Zero-Iteration Failure' and recommending system-level checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task reports 0 iterations, no tool calls, no artifacts, and the log ends abruptly or with only an initial error message.

say_en.text: Is this task a zero-iteration failure?
say_en.note: Claude checks iteration count, tool usage, and logs.

say_en.text: Analyze this log for initialization errors.
say_en.note: Claude tags the failure mode and suggests environment checks.
